description: Lossless editing JSON contract for com3d2.pmat.

Hash.description: The integer key used to associate the override with a material name.
Hash.title: Material lookup hash
Hash.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep it consistent with the game's hash function and MaterialName; let a format-aware writer recalculate it when supported.
Hash.x-meido-game-usage: ImportCM indexes the entry by this value and then checks that the resolved material name matches.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The loader reads CM3D2_PMATERIAL, stores the hash-keyed material name and render queue, and applies the queue when the material name matches.

MaterialName.description: The material name whose render queue is overridden.
MaterialName.title: Target material name
MaterialName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use the exact material name, including case conventions used by the game.
MaterialName.x-meido-game-usage: ImportCM compares it to the loaded Unity Material.name before applying the override.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The loader reads CM3D2_PMATERIAL, stores the hash-keyed material name and render queue, and applies the queue when the material name matches.

RenderQueue.description: The Unity render queue value applied to the matching material.
RenderQueue.title: Render queue
RenderQueue.x-meido-edit-guidance: Change in small, intentional steps and verify sorting and transparency in-game.
RenderQueue.x-meido-game-usage: ImportCM sets _SetManualRenderQueue and Material.renderQueue from this value.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The loader reads CM3D2_PMATERIAL, stores the hash-keyed material name and render queue, and applies the queue when the material name matches.

Shader.description: The shader string stored in the priority-material record.
Shader.title: Shader label
Shader.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it unless the target loader explicitly consumes it.
Shader.x-meido-game-usage: It is part of the record and hash input in MeidoSerialization; the reviewed priority lookup primarily applies MaterialName and RenderQueue.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The loader reads CM3D2_PMATERIAL, stores the hash-keyed material name and render queue, and applies the queue when the material name matches.

Signature.title: Priority-material signature
Signature.x-meido-game-usage: ImportCM validates this string before adding the entry to the priority-material cache.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The loader reads CM3D2_PMATERIAL, stores the hash-keyed material name and render queue, and applies the queue when the material name matches.

Version.description: The format version stored after the signature.
Version.title: Priority-material version
Version.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve the source value; use the target game's known version for new files.
Version.x-meido-game-usage: The reviewed reader consumes it for layout compatibility; it does not use it as the render queue.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The loader reads CM3D2_PMATERIAL, stores the hash-keyed material name and render queue, and applies the queue when the material name matches.
